name: Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention
short_description: A 227-room, 14-hectare mountain resort at the gateway to Puncak, integrated with Vimala Hills Villa & Resort.
ai_summary: Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention is a 5-star mountain resort in Gadog, Megamendung, at the gateway to the Puncak pass south of Bogor. Spanning 14 hectares and integrated with Vimala Hills Villa & Resort, the 227-room property overlooks Mount Salak and Mount Pangrango and offers four swimming pools, a full-service spa, three dining venues (Damar, Mad Cow steakhouse, Jade River), two bars, a Kids Club, and extensive family activities -- a mini zoo with horse riding, fishing pond, Rabbit & Deer Park, ATV trails, and an amphitheater. It won 'Hotel of the Year' at Accor's 2024 Asia Leadership Conference. It's about 64 km (roughly an hour) from Jakarta via the Cinere-Serpong route and 30 minutes from Bogor. Guests consistently praise the mountain views, extensive facilities, and family activity programming.

pros: 227 rooms, suites, and villas across 14 hectares with Mount Salak and Mount Pangrango views
Four swimming pools including a heated family pool and dedicated kids' pool
Three distinct dining venues plus two bars, including a Mad Cow steakhouse and Jade River Chinese restaurant
Extensive family activities: mini zoo with horse riding, fishing pond, Rabbit & Deer Park, ATV trails, weekend tie-dye workshop
Named 'Hotel of the Year' at the Accor Asia Leadership Conference 2024
cons: At roughly an hour from Jakarta and 30 minutes from Bogor, it's the most remote of the area's Accor properties
The resort's scale and activity list mean a short one-night stay may not cover all the facilities
research_highlights: Mountain views and the multi-pool, multi-restaurant scale are repeatedly cited as standout features
Family-oriented activity programming (mini zoo, ATV, tie-dye, horseback riding) draws consistent attention in 2025 press coverage
The resort's Hotel of the Year 2024 recognition from Accor is a notable industry accolade
research_watchouts: The Puncak-area drive from Jakarta can be considerably slower than the stated time during weekend traffic, a known regional issue

faqs.question: How far is Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills from Jakarta?
faqs.answer: It's about 64 km from Jakarta, roughly an hour by car via the Cinere-Serpong toll route, and about 30 minutes from Bogor city, though weekend Puncak-area traffic can slow the drive considerably beyond the stated time.

faqs.question: What family activities does Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills offer?
faqs.answer: The 14-hectare resort includes a mini zoo with horse riding, a fishing pond, a Rabbit & Deer Park, ATV trails, an amphitheater, and a weekend tie-dye workshop in the lobby, alongside four swimming pools and a Kids Club.
